correctness.rationale: Exact edge count C(m,2)-p yields all three (p,s) transitions; exchangeable tagged forbidden pairs give telescoping one-pair survival bounds and a two-pair survival moment bound. The single-remaining-pair survival factor 3/(4k^2-1) combines with k=floor(n^(1/5)) to give the proven 3/(4n)+O(n^(-6/5)); a separate labeled-subset exact dynamic program agrees for n<=7, and first/second moment bounds were checked for n<=18. Numerical convergence is not treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The graph is a canonical sparse deletion of the complete-graph adsorption substrate. The complete graph always deposits a perfect matching whereas the perturbation produces a quantitatively sharp 1/n failure probability despite asymptotically full coverage; the exact 3/4 constant is not recoverable from the coverage limit. The new finite-state reduction gives an exact finite-n benchmark and a mathematically motivated explanation through late surviving forbidden pairs, not an arbitrary table computation.
